args.title: Document BOM usage in CSV exports
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The Byte Order Mark (BOM) is included by default at the beginning of CSV exports. This is documented by the line `const { columns = COLUMN_ORDER, bom = true } = options;` and reinforced by comments explaining its use in spreadsheet applications for detecting UTF-8 encoding.

label: docs
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/export/csv.ts, the BOM (Byte Order Mark) is intentionally included at the beginning of CSV exports by default, as evidenced by the line: `const { columns = COLUMN_ORDER, bom = true } = options;`. This is further reinforced by the comment: 'Prefix a byte order mark. On by default.' and explained by 'Spreadsheet apps use the byte order mark to detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly.'.
